circumstances: User reported a suspicious IT-support impersonation email before clicking.
resolution: Sender domain blocked at gateway; no further action needed.

circumstances: User clicked a credential-harvesting link and entered their password on a lookalike login page.
resolution: Forced password reset, revoked active sessions, reviewed mailbox rules for forwarding.

circumstances: Phishing email with a malicious macro attachment was opened by a Finance user.
resolution: Endpoint isolated pending malware sweep; attachment hash blocklisted org-wide.

circumstances: Mass phishing campaign targeted 40+ mailboxes with a fake invoice theme.
resolution: Bulk quarantine of matching messages; sender domain and IP blocked at gateway.

circumstances: Trojan delivered via email attachment executed on a single workstation.
resolution: Endpoint isolated via EDR; binary hash added to blocklist; reimaged.

circumstances: Malware spread to 3 additional hosts via a shared network drive before detection.
resolution: All affected hosts isolated; shared drive access revoked and scanned; hash blocklisted.

circumstances: Fileless malware using PowerShell was detected via behavioral EDR rule, no dropped binary.
resolution: Process killed, PowerShell execution policy tightened, host monitored 72h.

circumstances: Malware attempted to disable endpoint AV before executing its payload.
resolution: EDR blocked the disable attempt; host isolated and reimaged as a precaution.

circumstances: Single account targeted with repeated failed logins from one external IP.
resolution: Source IP blocked at firewall; account forced password reset + MFA enrolled.

circumstances: Password-spray pattern hit 15 accounts from a rotating set of external IPs.
resolution: Rate-limiting enabled on the login endpoint; affected accounts forced to reset.

circumstances: Brute force succeeded on a service account with no MFA enrolled.
resolution: Account disabled immediately, credential rotated, MFA enforced org-wide for service accounts.

circumstances: VPN gateway brute force attempt targeted a recently offboarded employee's account.
resolution: Account already disabled per offboarding checklist; source IP blocked as a precaution.

circumstances: Critical CVSS 9.1 vulnerability found on an internet-facing web server.
resolution: Emergency patch applied within 48h per critical-CVE SLA.

circumstances: High-severity CVE found on an internal-only asset with no direct internet exposure.
resolution: Patched in the next scheduled maintenance window (7 days) per SLA for non-internet-facing assets.

circumstances: Vulnerable asset could not be patched immediately due to vendor software compatibility.
resolution: Compensating control (WAF rule + network segmentation) applied until a vendor-approved patch was available.

circumstances: Scan found the same unpatched CVE on 6 hosts sharing a base image.
resolution: Base image patched and hosts re-provisioned; scan re-run to confirm.

circumstances: Employee downloaded a large volume of customer records shortly before resigning.
resolution: Escalated to HR + Legal; device access suspended pending investigation.

circumstances: Employee accessed HR records outside their job function out of curiosity, no exfiltration confirmed.
resolution: Manager and HR notified; access re-scoped to least privilege; documented as a policy violation.

circumstances: Contractor copied proprietary design files to personal cloud storage.
resolution: Contractor access revoked immediately; cloud provider issued a takedown; legal review opened.

circumstances: Employee printed an unusually large batch of financial records after hours.
resolution: Physical access logs reviewed, printer logs correlated, no evidence of removal from premises found.

circumstances: Volumetric traffic spike against the public customer portal from thousands of IPs.
resolution: Upstream scrubbing enabled; traffic rerouted through CDN.

circumstances: Application-layer DDoS targeted the login endpoint specifically, not the whole site.
resolution: Rate-limiting and CAPTCHA challenge enabled on the login endpoint.

circumstances: DDoS coincided with a legitimate marketing campaign launch, initially mistaken for an attack.
resolution: Confirmed legitimate via traffic-source analysis; capacity scaled up instead of blocking.

circumstances: Sustained multi-day low-volume DDoS attempted to degrade service gradually.
resolution: Anomaly-based rate-limiting tuned over 2 days; traffic normalized.

circumstances: Large outbound transfer to an unsanctioned personal cloud storage account.
resolution: Outbound channel blocked at the proxy; account access suspended pending review.

circumstances: Sensitive-data-pattern files were uploaded to an external file-sharing domain by a departing employee.
resolution: Access revoked, cloud provider takedown requested, HR/Legal notified per offboarding policy.

circumstances: Anomalous outbound traffic volume to an unregistered external IP over several hours.
resolution: Traffic blocked at the firewall; host isolated for forensic imaging.

circumstances: Exfiltration attempt followed a support ticket requesting broader data access, later denied.
resolution: Access request denied retroactively confirmed correct; outbound attempt blocked; account flagged for monitoring.

circumstances: Account added to a privileged group with no matching change ticket.
resolution: Group membership reverted immediately; change-management process reviewed with the requesting team.

circumstances: Local privilege escalation exploit used a known unpatched vulnerability to gain SYSTEM access.
resolution: Host patched and reimaged; exploit path closed org-wide via emergency patch.

circumstances: Sudo access granted on a Linux host without an approved request, discovered during a routine audit.
resolution: Access revoked; audit log reviewed for any commands run while elevated (none found).

circumstances: Escalation followed a successful brute-force login on a low-privilege account.
resolution: Account disabled, escalation path patched, brute-force source IP blocked.

circumstances: Mass file-rename activity began on a single workstation, caught before spreading.
resolution: Host isolated within minutes via EDR auto-response; no other hosts affected.

circumstances: Shadow copy deletion command ran moments before encryption began on a file server.
resolution: Server isolated immediately; restored from the most recent clean backup.

circumstances: Ransomware indicator spread to 5 hosts on the same subnet before containment.
resolution: Subnet isolated at the switch level; all 5 hosts reimaged; backups verified clean before restore.

circumstances: Indicator triggered on a backup server itself, the highest-risk target.
resolution: Backup server isolated immediately; offline backup copies verified unaffected.

circumstances: Two logins for the same account from cities too far apart for the elapsed time.
resolution: Forced password reset and MFA re-enrollment; all active sessions revoked.

circumstances: Login from a never-before-seen device and location, MFA push was approved by the user without noticing.
resolution: User educated on MFA fatigue attacks; sessions revoked; device de-registered.

circumstances: Impossible-travel login was followed by mailbox forwarding-rule changes.
resolution: Forwarding rule removed, password reset, mailbox audit log reviewed for exfiltration.

circumstances: Two concurrent active sessions from different countries for a privileged admin account.
resolution: Both sessions terminated, admin credential rotated, privileged access temporarily suspended pending review.

circumstances: SQL injection attempt against the customer portal was blocked at the WAF.
resolution: Source IP blocked, WAF rule tightened for the matched payload pattern.

circumstances: XSS probes against a login page were followed by a successful payload reaching the app.
resolution: Vulnerable input field patched; affected sessions invalidated; WAF rule added as compensating control.

circumstances: Directory traversal attempt targeted an internal admin panel.
resolution: Panel access restricted to VPN-only; traversal vulnerability patched.

circumstances: Automated scanner fingerprinted the app before attempting several injection payloads, all blocked.
resolution: Source IP range blocked; rate-limiting added to slow future scans.

circumstances: Single workstation beaconed to a known-bad domain every 15 minutes.
resolution: Domain blocked at DNS layer; host isolated and reimaged.

circumstances: Beacon used a domain-generation algorithm, registering new lookalike domains daily.
resolution: DGA pattern blocked via threat-intel feed; host isolated pending forensic review.

circumstances: Beaconing was detected on a non-standard high port with low-and-slow timing to evade detection.
resolution: Egress filtering tightened to only approved ports/destinations; host reimaged.

circumstances: Two hosts on different subnets beaconed to the same external IP within the same hour.
resolution: Both hosts isolated; lateral-movement path identified and closed; both reimaged.
